subject: stf
title: STF.------IST.S.ALGN.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 465 (MP(I)-39). STF (source transfer) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From APP-RDEF: IST-F (isolated focus), ALT-D (alternative definitions) and CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts). From IST-F: IST-S-ALGN.
